# Piper TTS (vendored)

Run from `web/`:

```bash
npm run piper:fetch
```

This downloads:

- Windows `piper.exe` (+ ONNX Runtime / eSpeak data)
- `en_US-lessac-medium` (English names)
- `ru_RU-irina-medium` (Russian alert phrases)

Licenses: Piper / Piper voices — see upstream rhasspy/piper and rhasspy/piper-voices on Hugging Face.
